content: SQLite WAL: corruption cases from multi-connection concurrent write/checkpoint (WAL-reset bug fixed 3.51.3); long-lived read transactions block checkpoints causing -wal growth; WAL raises read/write concurrency only — writes still mutually exclusive, need busy_timeout and single-writer discipline. FTS5 unicode61 silently drops/mis-tokenizes CJK (whole runs become one token; MATCH '中文' returns 0 hits); fixes: trigram tokenizer, bigram preprocessing, ICU build, or external tokenizer (jieba/simple).
